name: Letter to Delgren
summary: Balthule Shadowstrike sends word from the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. His letter warns Delgren the Purifier of the Dark Strand cult's demonic work and must reach Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

sections.title: A Warning Sent South
sections.body: At the Tower of Althalaxx ruins, Balthule Shadowstrike watches the Dark Strand cult gather. He cannot destroy them alone, so he writes to Delgren the Purifier, his tutor in the Holy Light, and asks for aid. Their foul rites threaten more than Darkshore's coast. The letter must travel south through Darkshore into western Ashenvale. There, Delgren works with night elf Sentinels against demonic and undead threats.

faq.q: What is the Letter to Delgren?
faq.answer: Balthule Shadowstrike's sealed letter warns Delgren the Purifier of the Dark Strand cult's growing activity at the Tower of Althalaxx.

Delgren the Purifier is a human paladin at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale. He serves the Holy Light and aids the night elf Sentinels against demons and undead in the ancient forests. He also mentors Balthule in holy warfare.

faq.q: Why is Balthule sending the letter so far away?
faq.answer: Balthule is Delgren's pupil and seeks his mentor's skill against demonic corruption. At Maestra's Post, Delgren can draw on his combat prowess and the local Sentinel forces to oppose the Dark Strand's dark rituals.

faq.q: Where does this letter need to be delivered?
aliases: where do i take the letter
faq.answer: Carry the letter south through Darkshore and across the border into Ashenvale. Maestra's Post lies along the western road.

angles.text: As a paladin, you see a human paladin teaching a night elf the Holy Light. Their bond joins Kaldorei lands with the martial faith of the Eastern Kingdoms.
As an Alliance member, you see human champions and night elf Sentinels working together against demonic cults in northern Kalimdor.
